players.product: KEYTRUDA (pembrolizumab) anti-PD-1 therapy; intismeran autogene (V940/mRNA-4157), jointly developed with Moderna

quarterly_data.quarter: Merck & Co. press release: Merck Receives Positive EU CHMP Opinion for KEYTRUDA (09-18-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: The EMA's CHMP adopted a positive opinion recommending approval of KEYTRUDA (including KEYTRUDA SC) with Padcev as perioperative treatment for adults with resectable muscle-invasive bladder cancer regardless of cisplatin eligibility, with a European Commission decision expected by the fourth quarter of 2026. In the Phase 3 KEYNOTE-B15 trial (EV-304, with Pfizer and Astellas) in cisplatin-eligible patients the regimen reduced the risk of event-free-survival events by 47% (HR=0.53) and the risk of death by 35% (HR=0.65) versus neoadjuvant gemcitabine and cisplatin plus surgery, with a pathologic complete response rate of 55.8% versus 32.5%.
quarterly_data.figure: EFS HR 0.53 (47% reduction); OS HR 0.65 (35% reduction); pCR 55.8% vs 32.5%
